Define and manage work shift policies by: Define and manage work shift policies by configuring year, location, sub-location, shift names, and assigned status. Use the “Pending for Submission” state to review draft entries before publishing finalized shift plans visible to employees.
Configure organization-wide holiday cale: Configure organization-wide holiday calendars by year, location, sub-location, and shift name. Draft entries remain under “Pending for Submission” until reviewed and published, ensuring accurate holiday visibility across shifts and locations.
Define weekly off days for each shift ba: Define weekly off days for each shift based on year, location, and sub-location to align with regional schedules. Entries under “Pending for Submission” can be reviewed and published to ensure accurate weekend configurations across teams.
Configure allowed days and types of reim: Configure allowed days and types of reimbursable expenses such as Food, Flight, Travel, Medical, and Stay. Admins can add or update configurations to streamline claim rules and ensure policy compliance.
Manage DST settings by location, sub-loc: Manage DST settings by location, sub-location, and shift to align working hours across time zones. Admins can add, edit, and publish DST entries to ensure accurate time tracking during seasonal changes.
Set up department-wise clearance respons: Set up department-wise clearance responsibilities by assigning employee names and roles to ensure smooth offboarding. This module helps define which managers or HR personnel must clear dues before an employee exits the organization.
Define organizational roles like HR, Man: Define organizational roles like HR, Manager, or Employee and associate them with specific responsibilities. Roles serve as the base for access and approval structures.
Assign module access and specific action: Assign module access and specific actions like create, edit, or view to each role. This ensures users only see and perform tasks allowed for their role.
Map employees to their appropriate roles: Map employees to their appropriate roles so they inherit the correct permissions. This mapping ensures system-level access is accurately controlled.
Create leave types such as Sick Leave, P: Create leave types such as Sick Leave, Paid Leave, and Casual Leave and set rules like carry-forward or accrual. Categories are used in the employee leave application interface.
Configure yearly leave entitlements by s: Configure yearly leave entitlements by selecting year, location, sub-location, shift, and category. Allocate specific leave days to various grades to standardize time-off across departments and roles.
Assign personalized leave days by select: Assign personalized leave days by selecting year, location, sub-location, shift, category, and employee. This module allows tailoring leave entitlements at the individual employee level for greater flexibility and control.
Configure company-wide criteria for Comp: Configure company-wide criteria for Comp Off, Work From Home, and Permissions including entitlement rules and eligibility. Define global policies and regularization types with time-based values like expiry, past/future days, and minimum hour thresholds for full or half-day adjustments.

This module allows managing asset vendor: This module allows managing asset vendor details along with associated asset categories and subcategories. Admins can add or edit vendor information such as name, contact, status, email, and address, and organize assets under defined software and hardware categories.
This module displays a categorized list: This module displays a categorized list of forms under Active, Inactive, and Draft statuses for PMS, allowing admins to search, view, and manage form configurations. Each form lists its module, name, creator, last updater, and current status for easy tracking and control.
Expenses section allows employees to add: Expenses section allows employees to add new expenses and track their status across different stages including Draft, Approved, Pending, Processed, and Rejected. Users can search expenses and view details like Expense Title, Date, Total Amount, Status, and available actions.
This module enables creation and trackin: This module enables creation and tracking of employee review cycles with department, team, and location-level mapping. Users can create review cycles and link them to specific business units in order to track their status, such as Created or Initiated.
This module provides a detailed listing: This module provides a detailed listing of employees mapped to specific review cycles, with filters for department, location, and promotion status. It displays key information like review templates, current status, and final ratings to support performance evaluation tracking.
This screen displays the logged-in emplo: This screen displays the logged-in employee’s active performance review cycle, along with details such as department, team, location, due date, assigned template, and current review status. It allows employees to monitor and act on their pending assessments.
This screen allows managers to view and: This screen allows managers to view and manage performance reviews of their team members, including review cycle details, employee info, due dates, templates, and review statuses. It helps track progress and take timely actions on assessments.
This screen enables configuration of inc: This screen enables configuration of increment percentages based on employee ratings within a selected review cycle. Admins can define rating scales, set percentage slabs for specific salary ranges, and associate them with departments, teams, and locations.
This section allows administrators to co: This section allows administrators to configure assessors for a selected review cycle by mapping them to departments, teams, and locations. Each assessor can be assigned a deadline date, rating responsibility, and the ability to add comments for evaluations.
The Desk Allocation page enables efficie: The Desk Allocation page enables efficient workspace management by displaying desk statuses and allowing actions like reallocation, inactivation, maintenance scheduling, and viewing details. Users can filter by location, desk ID, type, shift, employee, and approver for precise control.
The Asset Management page offers a compr: The Asset Management page offers a comprehensive view of all assets, their status, and allocation details. Users can efficiently manage assets by reallocating, releasing, updating, or marking them as inactive or under maintenance, with access to detailed records for tracking.
The IT Support section allows users to r: The IT Support section allows users to raise new tickets by providing details such as Ticket Priority, Subject, Description, and impacted Department or Team. Users can track tickets across various statuses including All, Open, Awaiting User, Solved, and Rejected, with options to search and manage ticket actions.
The Organizational Hierarchy view displa: The Organizational Hierarchy view displays detailed reporting structure and compensation info for the selected employee. Options are available to download the data as PDF, JPG, or Excel.
The Holidays page displays public and op: The Holidays page displays public and optional holidays for the selected year, with the ability to change the year using a dropdown. Each holiday is shown with its name, date, and an event for easy reference.
The Employee Master Data Reports page al: The Employee Master Data Reports page allows generation and export of comprehensive Employee Master Data based on selected date ranges and employee status. It displays detailed employee information including personal, contact, educational, statutory, banking, and job-related details for accurate HR recordkeeping.
The Job Location Wise Data report lists: The Job Location Wise Data report lists employees filtered by job location and joining date. It includes personal details, contact numbers, and placeholders for job-related information such as role, shift, and department, allowing generation and export of structured job allocation data.
The Branch Location Wise Data report ena: The Branch Location Wise Data report enables generation of employee information based on selected branch locations. It filters records by branch code and joining date, helping HR teams organize, export, and analyze employee distribution across different office branches.
The Family Members Data report provides: The Family Members Data report provides information on employees' family members, including relationship and dependency details. It is generated based on employee status and supports export for records and compliance.
